goal: Equipment operator can assign a physical device without occupied schedule conflicts.
non_goals: Do not add a controller, permission, admin UI, device CRUD, lifecycle transition, schedule mutation flow, report, customer flow, database migration, third-party API call, or third-party write.
Do not change the existing foundation schema or fabricate occupied dates.
unsafe_assumptions: Current converted orders remain PENDING_ALLOCATION after an accepted assignment; a later fulfillment slice determines fully allocated order state.
All future occupied-schedule writers will acquire the same rental_device row lock before querying or inserting schedules.
stop_condition: Stop if the task needs an API/UI contract, lifecycle transition, schedule mutation flow, DDL change, third-party write, or files outside the allowed scope.
